description: Ministry of Education - Order made under Section 27(1) Department of Drama, Cinema and Television  University of Kelaniya
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the amendment of university faculties/departments (specifically adding the Department of Drama, Cinema and Television to the University of Kelaniya) under the Universities Act. While it mentions a minister by name, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities. This content falls under educational matters and academic administration, which is specifically categorized as Miscellaneous (Type 10) according to the classification guidelines.
